title: Project: table and stool

initial.text: Everything from this level together: add boxes and a cylinder, size them by number, duplicate and arrange.

steps.text: Add ▸ Mesh ▸ Cube for the tabletop.
Set Location Z to 0.75 m: the height of the top.
Object ▸ Transform ▸ Scale. The drag scales all three axes; the panel sets each one.
Scale X 0.8: the length.
Scale Y 0.5: the width.
Scale Z 0.05: a thin board.
Add another cube for a leg. It appears at the 3D cursor, at the floor.
Size 0.1 m: as thick as a leg.
Location X 0.7 m, under a corner.
Location Y -0.4 m.
Location Z 0.35 m: halfway up.
Scale it on Z only, to stretch it into a leg.
Scale Z 7.0: it now reaches the top.
Duplicate the leg along X.
Move X -1.4 m, to the other front corner.
Click the first leg.
Shift-click the copy: now both legs are selected.
Duplicate both at once, along Y, toward the back.
Move Y 0.8 m: four legs.
Add ▸ Mesh ▸ Cylinder for a stool.
Radius 0.3 m.
Depth 0.45 m: its height.
Location X 1.6 m, beside the table.
Location Z 0.225 m: half its height, so it stands on the floor.

outro: A table and a stool from boxes and a cylinder, all measured. That is Level 1.
